text:
jamie: Heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a p95 regression on the small-batch bench for rwd/gptx-3b-quant. CI alert: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/4943216789
ops-bot: [ALERT] nightly-bench p95 +18% vs baseline (window: 02:00–02:30). Metric: bench.small_batch.p95
sasha: ack. I'll try to reproduce on my dev GPU. Can someone capture a kernel timeline and cgroup stats?
praveen: on ded-01 now. which commit range should we bisect if needed? suspecting the runtime scheduler tweak from yesterday.
jamie: suspect range c1a2b3f -> e4d5f6a (runtime: small-batch scheduler + spinwait patch). Repro command below.
jamie: ```
./tools/nightly_bench --model rwd/gptx-3b-quant --batches 1,2,4 --seq-len 128 --runs 50 \n  --collect=kernel_timeline,kvcache,alloc_samples --seed=42
```
maria: grabbing nvprof + perf on ded-01, will capture 3 warmup iterations then full trace. Leaving perf sampling at 1000hz.
liam: quick check — did the quant lib bump land in the same deploy? PR #112 modified tensor pack/unpack.
sasha: running a lightweight local repro: observed a 12% p95 bump locally within 10 runs. attaching short log snippet.

sasha: ```
[2026-03-17 02:12:08] INFO bench: batch=1 seq=128 run=09 latency=41.9ms
[2026-03-17 02:12:12] INFO bench: batch=1 seq=128 run=10 latency=51.2ms  <-- spike
[2026-03-17 02:12:16] WARN runtime: kvcache miss rate 0.07
```
praveen: my full run finished on ded-01: p95 +19% same pattern. Uploading profiles to gs://rwd-perf/4943216789/
praveen: https://gcs.redwood.ai/rwd-perf/4943216789/summary.html
maria: kernel traces show flash-attn kernel time increased ~22% after commit e4d5f6a. Stack looks like change in batch splitter path.
maria: snippet from nvprof: ```
cuda_kernel 'flash_attn' time=3.2ms -> 3.9ms (avg)  # commit e4d5f6a
```
jamie: ok assigning: @sasha please run bisect across c1a2b3f..e4d5f6a with nightly_bench --quick (low runs) and post first regressive commit, @maria to dig kernel traces + flamegraphs, @praveen to hold ded-01 traces.
ops-bot: Created task PERF-7891: "nightly small-batch p95 regression (rwd/gptx-3b-quant)" — https://tracker.redwood.ai/browse/PERF-7891
sasha: will start bisect in ~30m (leaving runner on buildnode-2). I expect results within an hour.
jamie: thanks all — if the bisect points to runtime, we may revert the spinwait patch until we have patch. Keep updates in this thread.
praveen: note: reduced batch-sizes (1) hit the regression hardest, larger batches less affected.
maria: added flamegraphs to the GCS folder, naming: flame_4943216789_maria.svg
sasha: first bisect pass: regressed at commit e3f7a2c (partial change to kernel launch parameters). proceeding to narrow.
jamie: perfect. we'll reconvene here when bisect finishes. tl;dr: alert -> repro confirmed -> bisect in progress -> task PERF-7891 opened
liam: thx — let me know if you want a quick rollback candidate prepared
sasha: noted, will post final commit sha + revert PR if confirmed.
